text: How I go from 2100 to 1900 every time I get on Every single time I get on this game I start out a usually 2000, sometimes 2100. And when I start playing, I go on a losing streak and drop all the way down to 1900. Sometimes 1880. What have I noticed? The gap between 1900 and 2100 is based on 2 things: reading your opponents movement patterns (not attack patterns). punishing their movement patterns. From 1850-1950 players are pretty good at just punishing people when they miss. And people mostly miss because players are annoyingly passive, running away. They also get players to miss by baiting them. And the bait is 90% of the time just running, waiting at the edge of the stage, and waiting for their opponent to approach and try to attack, then countering or attack before they even get to them. How to reach 2000? read/feel opponents tempo/rhythm and move with it. Keep interrupting their rhythm punishing their movement mistakes and patterns. Players get careless and land places where it’s easy to hit them. Also jump towards players where it’s easy to hit them. They also repeatedly make the same movements (not attacks, movements) realize your own rhythm/tempo and change it constantly through the match. Don’t stay passive, don’t stay aggressive. Change yourself as the game goes on and realize what works against that opponent. realize all your combos fall short when your opponent can read your movement, attack patterns and tempo.

text:
We desperately need a NEW WEAPON. When a fighting game adds a new character, you get a completely new kit. New playstyle, new combos, new strings and it impacts the whole balance of the game.

This is not what happens when Brawlhalla adds a new legend. A new legend in brawlhalla simply adds a new combination of weapons with some new signature attacks. We don't get a new playstyle, new combos, new strings and it affects the balance of the game very minimally.

The meat of the game is in the light attacks, strings, combos. Sigs are honestly not that important, sigs are just extra.

New weapon for Brawlhalla, does what a new character does for every other fighting game. New weapon is what gives us a completely new playstyle, new combos, new strings and keeps the game exciting and fresh. The problem is that we get new weapons extremely rarely. It's like a fighting game that takes 2+ years between new characters, the game starts to become bit stale.

BMG needs to focus more on the new weapons, so we can get new playstyles, combos and strings.

OPINION: The Battlepass Isn't Bad Crowd Mentality/Negative Feedback Loop

As I've been following the recent battlepass news I've noticed a high amount of negative feedback. I can understand a certain amount of negative feedback on a battlepass, however the amount I see here seems pretty unwarranted and is starting to look more and more like a crowd mentality at this point.

Hate Due to Quality Drop (Brynn v. Thor/Ulgrim)

I feel like a lot of the hate that started coming in was due to the difference in quality between the first reveal (the brynn skin) and the next two (thor and ulgrim). As an artist in this community I feel like I have a bit of a say when it comes to the aesthetics of the game, and I can say that the Brynn skin is arguably the best BP Epic skin we've seen so far, and Ulgrim the worst. Thor has a bit of leeway, since it's not nearly as bad as the Ulgrim skin, but still doesn't do anything to stand out.
